reason: A provides the cleaner, more decisive test: same-batch solution-treated controls, a specified aging window, inert testing, and direct linkage of precipitate formation to strength and creep outcomes. B uses an inadequately defined two-stage treatment, confounds aging with an as-cast baseline and oxidation effects, and introduces an unsupported 10–15% falsification threshold; however, A still requires confirmation that aging forms stable coherent rather than brittle or rapidly coarsening Ti–Ni phases.
